basic_info.description: Enjoy a cup of coffee in the morning while watching the sunrise over the iconic SF skyline with views all the way to the Bay! Located in desirable Nob Hill, this fully renovated condo has everything you need to live a comfortable lifestyle. Situated in a boutique building on the flat stretch of Taylor Street, this turn-key, rent-control-exempt home is perfect for any discerning buyer looking to have it all. Enjoy open-concept living that makes way to the breathtaking views of San Francisco! A brand-new kitchen with warm, modern finishes and sleek appliances adds to the inviting setting-perfect for hosting gatherings with your loved ones. Bar seating for guests keeps you engaged while you whip up a good meal. Two spacious bedrooms include a primary suite with a remodeled ensuite bath with walk-in shower, and an additional fully remodeled bathroom in the hall. An-unit laundry was also installed for optimal convenience.  Priority parking in a secure garage and dedicated storage are also included with the unit. Just a short walk to many of the city's top restaurants, transportation, and downtown, you can't beat this turnkey condo in one of SF's most coveted neighborhoods.
